text:
Nadia M: Quick update on the Evora customer story: interview recorded this morning. Theyre fine with a short quote and a high-level performance callout, but legal wants controlled phrasing. We need assets + SDR handoff by next Wed.

Carlos V: Great. Can we get a bulleted launch checklist? I can own the benchmark visual + one quote card.

Nadia M: Checklist: 1) final quote/release signed, 2) 2-slide benchmark visual, 3) 60s customer clip, 4) gated webinar setup, 5) SDR routing + tags.

Hannah J: Legal flagged two things: avoid raw p95 numbers and use "up to" with percent claims. Also they want the product name in parentheses: "Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity)". I'll send the release draft.

Ravi K: For SDRs: we want inbound leads tagged with campaign=evora_launch and preferred_demo=invite-only. Initial demos are invite-only for 2 weeks per the customer.

Nadia M: Evora prefers the phrase: "~3x throughput and up to 60% lower inference cost vs. their previous setup." Use that exact wording for quote cards.

Carlos V: Noted. I'll design two LinkedIn cards and a small benchmark chart that says "customer reported" and "configurations vary" as the attribution.

Hannah J: Sent release to Evora legal just now. Asked for signature by Friday. If they push back we shift launch a week.

deploy-bot: Recording created:
- Event: Evora customer interview
- When: 2024-06-12 14:00 PT
- Link: https://meet.company/evora-interview

Ravi K: I'll build the webhook payload. Sample keys: id,email,company,lead_source,campaign,interest_tags,preferred_demo. Will add priority=enterprise rule.

Nadia M: Social plan: 60s clip + 15s cut, long blog, and a gated webinar (30 min + 10 Q&A). Jonah (Carlos), can you drop a v1 by Monday?

Carlos V: Yep. I'll upload PNG + PPTX to /marketing/evora-assets by Monday morning.

Hannah J: Evora legal replied with one edit: change product name to include parentheses. They signed after that tweak. Sending signed PDF to the drive.

Nadia M: Thanks Hannah — received. Carlos, update the quote card to the final wording. Ravi, once webhook is ready, run a smoke test with a dummy lead and tag it evora-launch.

Ravi K: Will run smoke test tomorrow at 10am PT. Also setting up gated page redirect to Playbook for approved invites.

Carlos V: Updated assets uploaded: drive.google.com/evora-assets. Quote card text updated to include the parentheses and "up to" language.

Nadia M: Final actions: Hannah - place signed release in /legal, Carlos - finalize visuals + clip, Ravi - SDR webhook + invite flow. Plan embargo until 2024-06-24 (customer requested Monday launch). I'll draft the playbook and share for review. :rocket:
